subject: MAP & evaluation assets: Acme AI pilot prompt pack and testcases
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: John Simmons <john.simmons@acme.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation assets: Acme AI pilot prompt pack and testcases

Hi John —

Great to meet earlier this week. As discussed, we can share a tightly scoped evaluation bundle so your engineers can run the pilot in a sandbox and validate performance/quality before the POC. To keep things simple I attached a first-pass pack and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) outlining milestones and a suggested close timeline.

What we are attaching now:
- redwood-prompt-pack-v1.zip (prompt templates + canonical instructions)
- redwood-eval-testcases-v1.jsonl (1000 labelled test cases, JSONL)
- provisional-MAP-2025-04-18.pdf (milestones + dates)
- evaluation-usage-constraints.txt (usage & redistrib rules)

Key constraints (summary):
- Use permitted: internal evaluation, sandbox, models for the pilot only.
- Prohibited: public benchmarking or redistribution outside Acme without prior written consent.
- Data retention: delete copies 90 days after pilot close unless we agree otherwise.
- Watermarking: we ask that any artifacts shared back to Redwood are flagged as "pilot-derived" for traceability.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Delivery: we hand off assets within 48 hours of agreement (target: Apr 20)
2) Eval window: 2 weeks of engineering validation (Apr 21–May 4)
3) Feedback & sync: technical review week of May 5
4) Close/decision: target May 9 — aim to finalize next steps by then

If that timeline works, we can lock in a short addendum to the NDA to capture the usage constraints and then proceed with delivery. Looping in Lauren (solutions) to coordinate any ingestion help and Dev (security) for the handling notes.

Thanks —
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of GTM Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: John Simmons <john.simmons@acme.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pilot Team <pilot@acme.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation assets: Acme AI pilot prompt pack and testcases

Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed MAP. A few quick questions from our side before we sign off:
1) Can our external contractors (we use two ML consultants) access the assets if they are on Acme's employee-managed sandbox?
2) Is it okay to run the eval on a hosted non-production cluster (not Redwood) provided we keep it isolated?
3) On the delete/retention: can we request a 120-day window for internal reproducibility?

Legal on our side will want the specific wording for "no public benchmarking" — can you send the exact clause we should include in the NDA addendum?

If we can confirm those points today we can accept the MAP and aim for your April 20 delivery.

—John
John Simmons
Sr. Director, Applied ML — Acme AI
john.simmons@acme.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: John Simmons <john.simmons@acme.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation assets: Acme AI pilot prompt pack and testcases

John — thanks for the quick note. TL;DR: contractors are OK under a holder-of-duty model, hosted non-prod clusters OK if isolated, retention we can flex to 120 days if needed. Details below and I added Monica to confirm legal language.

Answers: 
- Contractors: permitted provided they are bound by equivalent confidentiality (we can add a one-paragraph flowdown clause to the addendum).
- Non-Redwood hosted eval: allowed for the pilot so long as the environment is isolated, not accessible publicly, and follows the security checklist in the evaluation-usage-constraints.txt. Dev, would you call out anything else?
- Retention: we can extend to 120 days for this pilot; please include that in the addendum request.

Monica — can you review / propose short NDA addendum language that explicitly covers: non-redistribution, no public benchmarking, contractor flowdown, 120-day retention, watermarking flag for returned artifacts. We prefer a one-paragraph addendum or an exhibit to avoid delaying the pilot.

If all good we’ll attach the addendum and deliver the assets by Apr 20 EOD.

Thanks —
Rishi

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: John Simmons <john.simmons@acme.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Apr 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP & evaluation assets: Acme AI pilot prompt pack and testcases

Hi John / Rishi —

Thanks — I reviewed the constraints and drafted a short addendum (attached) that we think captures the items you asked about. Summary of the addendum language (high level):
- Purpose: limited evaluation use for the Pilot (explicitly non-production).
- Redistribution: no external redistribution; contractors allowed if bound by Acme to identical confidentiality obligations (flowdown clause).
- Benchmarking: explicit prohibition on publishing or broadcasting performance metrics derived from the supplied eval artifacts without prior written consent.
- Retention: 120 days for this pilot (we can renew by mutual agreement).
- Watermarking & returned artifacts: request that artifacts returned to Redwood include a "pilot-derived" metadata flag.

I attached: evaluation-NDA-addendum-Acme-2025-04-21.pdf (added as a short exhibit) and a marked-up provisional-MAP with timelines updated to reflect the 120-day retention.

If that looks good, John, please have your legal sign the addendum (DocuSign link below) and we will push the assets.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/XYZ-ACME-ADDENDUM-2025

Regards,
Monica
Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: John Simmons <john.simmons@acme.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pilot Team <pilot@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation assets: Acme AI pilot prompt pack and testcases

Monica — thanks for the addendum and fast turnaround. A couple of tiny redlines from our counsel:
- Change the "120 days" retention to "120 days from pilot close or 150 days if necessary for reproducing reported results" (they want a short extension clause).
- Add a short carve-out that allows Acme to share derived internal bug-reports with our external cloud provider (they're sensitive but we think that's reasonable under confidentiality).

Neither is a blocker; if you can accept those edits we can sign today. DocuSign looks fine.

—John

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: John Simmons <john.simmons@acme.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation assets: Acme AI pilot prompt pack and testcases

John / team —

Appreciate the quick review. Monica accepted both minor edits: retention updated to "120 days from pilot close (150 days if required for reproducing reported results)" and a narrow carve-out permitting sharing of anonymized bug-reports with Acme's cloud provider under the same confidentiality terms. I signed the updated addendum on behalf of Redwood and executed the DocuSign envelope.

Next steps:
- We will deliver the final asset bundle today (attached: redwood-prompt-pack-v1.zip, redwood-eval-testcases-v1.jsonl).
- MAP updated & attached: final-MAP-2025-04-22.pdf (milestones revised)
- Pilot eval window: Apr 23 — May 6 (two weeks)
- Decision close: target May 9

Lauren and Dev are standing by for ingestion or security checklist help. Thanks for the partnership — looking forward to the results.

Best,
Rishi

Attachments referenced: redwood-prompt-pack-v1.zip (zip archive), redwood-eval-testcases-v1.jsonl (JSONL), final-MAP-2025-04-22.pdf (PDF)
